_comment: Seeded external signals covering every guardrail bucket, so the filter can be demonstrated. Sourced from the Case 16 India storyline. Replace with a live feed once the team confirms trigger definitions.

signals.title: RetailCo announces 20-store expansion across Delhi NCR and Punjab
signals.rationale: Customer expansion served from DC_DELHI; store count and opening schedule stated in a published investor update.

signals.title: Diesel prices expected to rise 8% following crude increase and subsidy reduction
signals.rationale: Global crude price increase plus reduced subsidies expected in Q4; feeds a transport-cost sensitivity scenario.

signals.title: Northbound carrier reduces available fleet capacity on Delhi-Guwahati corridor
signals.rationale: Carrier withdrew 40 vehicles from the corridor; directly affects lanes we operate to DC_GUWAHATI.

signals.title: Component supplier reports two-week production halt at Pune facility
signals.rationale: Written notification from a tier-1 supplier feeding PLT_PUNE; inbound availability is directly affected.

signals.title: Rival network operator opens new distribution centre in Nagpur
signals.rationale: Competitor infrastructure announcement. Retained for visibility; excluded from optimisation by team decision.

signals.title: Wholesale price index up 0.9% month on month
signals.rationale: Routine monthly index movement below the materiality threshold; expected to be logged rather than surfaced.

signals.title: Cyclone warning issued for Odisha and West Bengal coast
signals.rationale: IMD warning covering the region served by DC_KOLKATA; time-boxed and auto-expires after the disruption window.
